name: Braenna Flintcrag
summary: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Braenna Flintcrag guides dwarves in the ways of the Holy Light. She trains priests in healing and spiritual discipline, and tells visiting night elf priests when they are called home to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

sections.title: A Guide in the Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: Braenna Flintcrag trains priests in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. From the Mystic Ward, she teaches dwarven acolytes the Holy Light's healing arts and defensive wards, preparing them for a dangerous world. Her work tends the spiritual needs of Khaz Modan, amid a city renowned for its forges and warriors.

faq.answer: Braenna Flintcrag trains priests in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. She teaches holy prayers, spells, and spiritual disciplines.

faq.q: Where can I find Braenna Flintcrag?
faq.answer: You can find Braenna Flintcrag in the Hall of Mysteries, within Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What services does she provide to travelers?
faq.answer: Braenna Flintcrag trains Alliance priests and advances their ranks. She also tells visiting night elf priests when they are called home to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Is she related to anyone else in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: Braenna Flintcrag shares her surname with Thulman Flintcrag, suggesting a connection to a notable dwarven lineage in Khaz Modan.

angles.text: As an Alliance priest, you can learn essential spells and study the Light with Braenna Flintcrag in Ironforge.
As a dwarf, you can see Ironforge's devotion to the Holy Light in Braenna Flintcrag's work alongside the city's martial traditions.
